questions.stem: The sisters plant beans on their farm. They w________ before breakfast.
questions.hint: grow crops on the ground that belongs to the subject

passages.text: The technology club plans a model house for the school fair. Its roof has a small panel that uses solar power to run a tiny fan in sunlight. One member asks whether visitors may move the model closer to the window. “Of course, if we move it carefully together,” says the club leader. They mark a clear place on the table so that the panel will not be shaded by another model. Their explanation card tells visitors what supplies the energy and why the position matters.

parallelText.en: The technology club plans a model house for the school fair.
parallelText.zh: 科技俱乐部计划为学校展会制作一座模型房。

parallelText.en: Its roof has a small panel that uses solar power to run a tiny fan in sunlight.
parallelText.zh: 屋顶有一块小面板，在阳光下利用太阳能驱动一只小风扇。

parallelText.en: One member asks whether visitors may move the model closer to the window.
parallelText.zh: 一位成员问，能不能让参观者把模型移得离窗户更近。

parallelText.en: “Of course, if we move it carefully together,” says the club leader.
parallelText.zh: “当然可以，只要我们一起小心地移动它，”社团负责人说。

parallelText.en: They mark a clear place on the table so that the panel will not be shaded by another model.
parallelText.zh: 他们在桌上标出清楚的位置，避免面板被其他模型遮挡。

parallelText.en: Their explanation card tells visitors what supplies the energy and why the position matters.
parallelText.zh: 说明卡告诉参观者能量来自哪里，以及为什么摆放位置重要。

passages.text: At the clubs fair, pupils visit different tables to learn what each group does. The photography club shows its equipment, including a camera, a stand and a small lamp. Members let visitors look closely before explaining which items may be tried with help. Hana likes taking pictures but needs help with the camera stand, so she asks for a demonstration. She learns how it keeps the camera still and writes down the club’s meeting time. She plans to ask more questions before choosing a club, rather than joining only because a table looks exciting.

parallelText.en: At the clubs fair, pupils visit different tables to learn what each group does.
parallelText.zh: 在社团招募展上，学生们到不同展台了解各社团的活动。

parallelText.en: The photography club shows its equipment, including a camera, a stand and a small lamp.
parallelText.zh: 摄影社团展示了设备，包括相机、支架和小灯。

parallelText.en: Members let visitors look closely before explaining which items may be tried with help.
parallelText.zh: 成员先让参观者仔细看，再说明哪些器材可以在帮助下试用。

parallelText.en: Hana likes taking pictures but needs help with the camera stand, so she asks for a demonstration.
parallelText.zh: 哈娜喜欢拍照，但需要有人帮助她使用相机支架，于是请人演示。

parallelText.en: She learns how it keeps the camera still and writes down the club’s meeting time.
parallelText.zh: 她了解到支架如何固定相机，并记下社团聚会时间。

parallelText.en: She plans to ask more questions before choosing a club, rather than joining only because a table looks exciting.
parallelText.zh: 她打算在选择社团前多问几个问题，而不是只因展台看起来精彩就加入。
